closure_review.finding: No stage4 fixture requires closure byte-mask layout traversal based on source/call-path audit. Seven closure-call sources use capture-free Fn/FnOnce closures; CheckUninitVisitor transfers only union/MaybeUninit shadows, and delayed target seeding/setters do not target closure values. reset_nested_call may probe PointeeInfo::from_ty on a moved closure; UnsupportedType is only compared against UnionAsField and silently yields false, with no diagnostic. No stage4 contract macro generates a hidden closure companion.
closure_review.stage5_reason: Input has #[kani::modifies(out)] and #[kani::proof_for_contract(write)]; generated proof-for-contract companion is the captured PFC path. D1 explicitly sets owner_slice=5/integration_head=5; keep there.
closure_review.marked_model_reason: Direct nondet_fn1 model + custom Arbitrary::any body/ordinary union result; source and resolved helper path contain no closure environment.

source_audit_evidence.finding: seeded targets are pointer casts with differing pointee sizes, copy intrinsics, raw_eq; ordinary call operands do not seed targets
entry setters and place reads/writes require needs_set/needs_get based on target ancestor intersection
transfers_shadow is only union or MaybeUninit storage; stage4 paired call protocol filters F closure arguments out and loads a MaybeUninit return only
closure layout traversal is reached through typed/storage data-mask paths; no such call for non-shadow closure values in the audited call path

reset_nested_call probes PointeeInfo::from_ty for moved args; Closure may yield UnsupportedType, but needs_nested_call_reset matches only UnionAsField and emits no Unsupported. It cannot be treated as a stage5 blocker.

limitations: Static source and MIR-transform implementation-path audit only; no local compilation, MIR dump, CI, or verifier run. Inputs and goldens are exact content hashes from F.
